author: Blyth, 1848
summary: 해마다 10건 미만으로 기록되는 길잃은새로, 봄과 가을에 갯벌과 하구에서 가끔 보인다. 큰 소리로 '칩-칩' 하고 운다. 중국 만주와 러시아 우수리 지역에서 번식하고, 우리나라를 거쳐 동남아시아에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: straight, all-black bill with a blunt tip

young: 목과 옆구리는 황갈색이고, 윗면은 어두운 갈색에 깃 가장자리가 흐린 갈색이다. 어두운 눈선이 뚜렷하다.

similar.how: 생김새는 비슷하지만 이 종은 부리가 곧고 끝이 뭉툭하며 전체가 검다.
흑꼬리도요는 부리 기부가 분홍색이고 꽁지 끝이 검다.

art.subject: Asian Dowitcher (Limnodromus semipalmatus), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean tidal flats on spring passage (late April–May): head, neck, breast and belly deep brick-red, with a dark loral stripe and a dark-streaked crown; mantle and scapulars blackish with rufous and buff fringes; wing coverts greyer brown; lower belly and vent whitish with a few dark bars on the rear flanks; bill entirely black, long and straight with a slightly swollen, blunt tip; dark eye; legs blackish-grey.
art.pose: standing on a tidal mudflat, side view
art.scene: Korean tidal mudflat at a river mouth during spring migration (late April–May); no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding (spring), side view standing on mud: brick-red head, neck, breast and belly, blackish back with rufous fringes, straight all-black bill with a blunt, slightly swollen tip, dark legs
adult winter, side view standing: white supercilium, grey-brown crown and upperparts with neat white fringes, whitish underparts with grey-brown marks on the breast, same straight all-black bill
juvenile (autumn), side view standing: buff neck, breast and flanks, dark brown upperparts with neat pale buff-brown fringes, bold dark eye-stripe below a pale supercilium
art.build: Large, heavy dowitcher, about 35cm, near Bar-tailed Godwit size but stockier and shorter-necked. Bill very long, about twice head length, perfectly straight, all black, staying thick to a slightly swollen, blunt tip. Legs fairly long, dark grey to black. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. In flight a pale, finely barred rump and lower back without a clean white wedge, and a pale underwing. Probes vertically with rapid 'sewing-machine' movements, often wading belly-deep.
avoid: Do not paint a pink base to the bill or an upturned bill; that is Bar-tailed or Black-tailed Godwit.
Do not paint a black tail band or a bold white wing-bar; those belong to Black-tailed Godwit (Limosa limosa).
Do not paint yellowish-green legs or a white back wedge; those suit Long-billed Dowitcher (Limnodromus scolopaceus).
Do not taper the bill to a fine point; it stays thick to a blunt, slightly swollen tip.
